fields.title: Poacher's Den
fields.desc: The cliffs of the Cantas Valley feature natural caves of various shapes and sizes, favored as hideouts by the many poachers who ply their illicit trade in and around the valley.

fields.title: Spirit Flower Cave
fields.desc: Spirit Flowers have been known to grow in some hidden caves along the middle reaches of the Ellun River. Once common, they have become increasingly rare due to pollution and indiscriminate illegal harvesting for use as a medicinal herb or ingredients for magic. A number of groups have occupied the caves and are indiscriminately harvesting Spirit Flowers ille

fields.title: Cursed Hideout
fields.desc: Sura are Daeva who mutated after having all of their life energy drained by the Balaur. A number of Sura secluded themselves in caves while they still retained their sanity, attempting to halt their mutation. Ultimately, however, all succumbed to their fate of becoming mindless monsters.

Elyos.name: Title: I'll Take You All On

fields.title: Mysterious Mushroom Cave
fields.desc: The Cantas Valley is home to a colony of giant mushrooms that grow higher than the trees. These giant mushrooms greatly favor caves with moist soil and adequate humidity.

fields.title: Cave of the Defeated
fields.desc: The battle at the Nahid Brigade Fortress ended in total defeat for the Daeva. Many were captured or succumbed to extinction, and what few survived went into hiding in places such as the Cave of the Defeated.

Elyos.name: Title: In the Heart of Enemy Territory

fields.title: Filth Pit
fields.desc: A cave located in the Contaminated Marsh, polluted by the sewage and refuse of Nahid Brigade Fortress and the Drana Plantation. Hidden among the waste are a number of documents detailing the Balaur's Surana experiments.

fields.title: Illusionary Ruins
fields.desc:
A cave where pilgrims worshipping the Illusion God practiced meditation. The High Priestess of Illusion summoned Spirits to guard this place for the pilgrims, but after strange things began happening in the garden following her disappearance, pilgrims gradually stopped coming.
Now, only the Spirits remain, guarding an empty cave.

fields.title: Dehinon's Hideout
fields.desc: The hiding place of Dehinon, who is both Daeva and non-Daeva. Kidnapped and taken to the Nahid Brigade's base, he managed to escape in the process of being turned into a Sura. Hiding in this cave with his comrades, he is slowly losing his sanity.

Elyos.name: Title: A Whale in a Shrimp Fight

fields.title: Guardian's Armory
fields.desc: A secret armory of the Guardians who resisted the Balaur to the last. No one knows if there are still any useful weapons.

fields.title: Cave of the Desperate
fields.desc: This cave is where defeated Guardians hid from the Balaur and eventually met their ends. It holds the records of the Guardians of Verteron, who fought a fierce battle against the Ishtar Brigade.

fields.title: Hidden Valley
fields.desc:
A deep gorge formed by tectonic shifts.
Suspicious individuals of unknown identity have regularly been seen coming and going.

fields.title: Distorted Cave
fields.desc: A cave where a passage to the Abyss has appeared. It contains information about the Ancient City of Ru.

fields.title: Corrupted Spiritmaster's Residence
fields.desc: A cave serving as the hiding place of Deios, a corrupted Spiritmaster who was one of many who lost their way following Kaisinel's extinction and the dissolution of the Illusion Cavaliers. Out of sight of other Daeva, Deios has been researching dangerous magic in hopes of finding a way to control the spirits of Etheria.

fields.title: Karat's Nest
fields.desc: After the destruction of the Abyss Gate of Verteron Fortress, some of the Klaw that lived in the Abyss have settled in the Verteron Fortress Ruins. The Klaw queen, Karat, spawns from her nest and seeks to expand their territory.

fields.title: Kius' Residence
fields.desc: A base belonging to the notorious criminal Kius and his followers. The bounty on his head from the Notos Legion has grown higher and higher, but no one has dared attempt to capture him.

fields.title: Lupyllini Habitat
fields.desc: A cave deep within the secluded reaches of Cantas Valley, chosen by the Lupyllini to make their nests. Long used by bandits from nearby mountains to hide their looted treasures, the presence of Lupyllini has made it all but impossible for humans to approach, leaving the treasures piled inside to gather dust with nobody to lay claim to them.

fields.title: Looted Repository
fields.desc: A granary used by the residents of Verteron until Dratona forces turned it into a Balaur lair. The Dratona captain, Nagto, has wasted no time in pocketing the accumulated grain.

fields.title: Abandoned Odylium Cave
fields.desc: Drawn by its rich veins of Odylium—a rarity in Odyle-depleted Verteron—, this cave is crawling with Sura who escaped the Nahid's Brigade's laboratories. Though it boasts a vault filled with treasures of long-dead Daeva, many of which contain Odylium, few dare approach due to the Sura threat.

fields.title: Solitary Rock Tomb
fields.desc: A cave that now stands as a tomb to pilgrims who succumbed to Sura mutation. Their fellow Illusion God pilgrims continue to pray inside, wishing them peaceful slumber, but the Sura—whose grudges run deep—may awaken again at any moment.

Elyos.name: Title: Pilgrim to the Holy Land

fields.title: Kidnapper's Hold
fields.desc: Ishtar developed a technology called Surana capable of extracting the life force of Daeva and converting it into alternative energy. To facilitate research and development, numerous groups of Balaur dedicated themselves to systematically hunting Daeva and other lifeforms for use as experimental subjects, imprisoning them in nearby bases and supplying them to

fields.title: Marsh Library
fields.desc: A secret library built by the librarian Hypatia to preserve the knowledge of the Elyos, under the sworn protection of the Kerubar. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

Elyos.name: Title: The High Walls of Elysium

fields.title: Krall Barracks
fields.desc: Krall are assigned by the Balaur to handle the disposal of the large amounts of waste produced by experiments conducted in Nahid Brigade Fortress, and of the byproducts produced by the nearby Drana Plantation. The number of Krall specialized in these tasks is substantial enough to require an entire barracks.

fields.title: Canyon Library
fields.desc: A library built in Altamia Canyon by the librarian Hypatia. Fearing it would be attacked and the accumulated knowledge within lost, she distributed the books across multiple other libraries.

fields.title: Chilly Hideout
fields.desc: It is not uncommon for those undergoing Sura mutation to deny reality and seek to return to their original forms by curing their symptoms, hiding away as they conduct research through often unethical methods.

fields.title: Cave Storage
fields.desc: A place to store the Aullaeu's belongings. Pinos, Aullaeu's minions, serve as laborers.

fields.title: Grave of the Wrathful Dead
fields.desc: After being defeated by Ishtar's armies, some Daeva suffered extinction, some became Sura, and some even became Apparitions. The wrathful screams of those Daeva Apparitions are heard day and night.

fields.title: Akilo Thieves Den
fields.desc: A den of the Akilo Thieves who have become somewhat notorious in the Ellun River Midstream.

fields.title: Deadly Poison Den
fields.desc: A cave located deep in the Tolbas Forest. The cave is inhabited by highly poisonous plants and animals, making it difficult to access.

fields.title: Herb Cave
fields.desc: A cave known to grow rare herbs. However, the animals that ate the herbs grew too strong, and the cave became inaccessible to humans.

fields.title: Looted Pilgrim's Rest
fields.desc: A site of pilgrimage where worshippers of Kaisinel stop and write devotionals. Popularized by a legend that he once stayed here briefly, it is now home only to lost spirits.

fields.title: Targoth's Cave
fields.desc: A cave used for mass burial of those killed by Meslamtaeda's poison. After consuming the contaminated corpses, the Targos inside have mutated and taken over the cave for themselves.

fields.title: Broken Hall of Knowledge
fields.desc: A site assumed to be a former part of Zumion Temple. Now little more than broken ruins, perhaps it might contain records of ancient times.

fields.title: Deep Underground Cave
fields.desc: Inherently inquisitive, the Creion are famed for seeking out dangerous places to conduct dangerous experiments. This cave is one of many such places, abandoned following an experiment that ended in failure. However, perhaps they left some valuable items behind.

Elyos.name: Title: The Keep, the Cave, and the Wardrobe

fields.title: Fortress Jail
fields.desc: A jail situated under the Verteron Fortress. Though currently under Krall control, it still contains many relics and writings of Illusion Cavaliers.

fields.title: Scribe's Room
fields.desc: The Scribe's Room is believed that it was part of the Zumion Temple. The scribe left behind many records, but those on paper have been weathered away by time, and only a few stone tablets remain.

fields.title: Red Dragon Altar
fields.desc: The Aullaeu worshipped Dragon Lord Tiamat for generations. Even following her fall and the ascendance of Dragon Lord Ishtar, they did not falter in their worship, and continue to dedicate altars to her.

fields.title: Wild Biruta Habitat
fields.desc: A cave inhabited by Biruta—unique creatures found in Tolbas Forest and prized by the Shugo for the special properties of their leaves. The gentle-natured Biruta live quietly in small family groups throughout the cave.

fields.title: Fissure Cave
fields.desc: A cave where a passage to the unstable Abyss has appeared. It contains information about the Ancient City of Ru.

fields.title: Renegade Base
fields.desc: There are Daeva who, despite not being Sura, have strayed from the Daeva path and sworn to serve the Balaur. This cave is the home to such Daeva Renegades.

fields.title: Klaw Den
fields.desc: A cave where a group of Klaw live. It is said that there is a special herb that grows in the Klaw habitat.

fields.title: Rift Cave
fields.desc: A cave where a passage to the unstable Abyss has appeared. It contains additional information about the Ancient City of Ru.

fields.title: Deep and Dark Pit
fields.desc: Following Kaisinel's disappearance, contracts with the spirits were broken and Etheria grew increasingly unstable, resulting in many spirits turning violent. This cave is one such place overrun with unruly spirits.

fields.title: Wild Kuru Habitat
fields.desc: A rest stop for Kuru working under the Aullaeu, where they can often be seen lounging around after a hard day's work.

fields.title: Fortress Grave
fields.desc: A burial vault beneath Verteron Fortress. It likely contains a great number of Daeva relics, with its underground location having allowed it to escape Balaur bombardment.

fields.title: Anguish Hideout
fields.desc: A cave where Daeva fleeing the Balaur hid while gathering their strength for a counterattack.

fields.title: Aullaeu Oratory
fields.desc: A prayer hall within the Aullaeu Village, where a fanatical band of Aullaeu devoted to Ishtar is said to gather.

Elyos.name: Title: Can I Go to the Bathroom?

fields.title: Prison of Exiles
fields.desc: An exile colony home to legionnaires and Cavaliers who committed heinous crimes. Following the Balaur occupation of Verteron, it fell under Aullaeu control and now imprisons those banished from the Urugugu tribe.

Elyos.name: Title: I Take Care of My Own

fields.title: Kraka's Altar
fields.desc: The resting place of Kraka, a legendary chieftain of the Tursin Krall. The Krall worship him still—building altars and offering tribute.

fields.title: Dratona Outpost
fields.desc: An outpost garrisoned by the Dratona troops who monitor the Drana Plantation.

fields.title: Balaur Scouts Campsite
fields.desc: A temporary home for the Draconute scouts who monitor the area around Drana Plantation.

fields.title: Altar of Hope
fields.desc: A place where an ancient Zumion Priestess sealed herself away together with Meslamtaeda's poison, enduring intense agony as she continues her solitary battle.

fields.title: Experimental Prison Compound
fields.desc: A facility where the Balaur imprison experimental subjects for post-experiment monitoring. Those who underwent mutation and those still retaining human form are confined together, creating a tense atmosphere.

fields.title: Balaur Scouts Outpost
fields.desc: An outpost of the Balaur scouts patrolling the Altamia Canyon area. A number of innocent residents of Altamia Canyon are imprisoned inside in terrible conditions.

fields.title: Hidden Ruins Altar
fields.desc: The place where Spatalos, former high commander of the Verteron Legion, sealed away Vamana, a vanguard captain of the Drakan. According to folklore, the echoes of their battle can still be heard.

fields.title: Laborers Training Ground
fields.desc:
A labor training facility where Cogni under Balaur command are trained to be laborers.
Kobold, Dracuni, and Balaur live together in this space.
 is assigned as the captain of the training facility.

fields.title: Konutin's Cave
fields.desc: A cave used by Aullaeu Shamans for their ritual studies, guarded by Konutins stationed in the area.

fields.title: Plantation Storage
fields.desc: A Balaur storage that holds Drana, Drana by-products, and the supplies needed to grow Drana.

fields.title: Bibliophile's Grave
fields.desc: It is the grave of an unknown reader who never let go of a book until the moment of the death. There may have been some rare books in the reader's collection.

fields.title: Forest Library
fields.desc: A secret library built in Tolbas Forest by the librarian Hypatia to preserve the knowledge of the Elyos.

fields.title: Collapsed Fortress Basement
fields.desc: The underground part of the fallen Verteron Fortress. It is used by the Krall as their residence.

fields.title: Hidden Lepharist Research Center
fields.desc:
One of the many hidden Lepharist research centers spread across Eltnen.
The facility is home to a myriad of research initiatives—including processing Drana into energy and breeding test subjects.
However, its test subject research has been halted for reasons unknown.

fields.title: Abandoned Life Hideout
fields.desc:
When the Ishtar Legion laid waste to Eltnen, the Life Daeva paid a heavy toll in blood. Those who survived withdrew to hidden outposts, quietly working to restore their ruined home.
But as the Lepharists invaded, the last of the Life Daeva were forced into hiding and ultimately disappeared.
Though this cave once sheltered them, it now stands empty and forgot

fields.title: Life Awakening Site
fields.desc:
Once an annex attached to the Eltnen Barrier Tower, this area served as a final refuge for the Life Daeva when the tower collapsed.
In the end, the Balaur stormed the halls, slaughtering nearly all the Daeva hidden within.
Yet, even in the shadow of death, life still blooms. It was here that Kion, the very last of the Life Daeva, was able to ascend.

fields.title: Sunken Ancient Legacy
fields.desc:
A small cavern tucked away on the outskirts of the Ruberein Hills. While it appears completely ordinary from the outside, there are whispers of an endless spring of pristine water deep within. Rumor has it that the source of this pure water is an ancient relic left behind by the Life Daeva, hidden far beneath the spring's depths.
Drawn by these tales, bandit

Elyos.name: Title: How Deep Does This Go?

fields.title: Ishtar Logistics Base
fields.desc: A supply base that once stored and distributed combat provisions for the Ishtar Brigade during the Balaur's ancient war. It was particularly notorious for its mobile bombs, which inflicted massive Daeva casualties. Even now, long after the Balaur have occupied Eltnen, several of these mobile bombs remain deep within the base. Due to the passage of time, no o

fields.title: Drok the Outlaw's Den
fields.desc:
The majority of refugees in Eltnen have gathered and live in the Refugee Camp on Eiron Hill.
Most Eiron Hill refugees are peaceful and law-abiding, maintaining good relations with the Tsenka Merchants and Chloris.
Drok and his band of outlaws are an outlier. By inciting disgruntled refugees to desert their camp, Drok has established a base for him and his gr

fields.title: Filthy Cave
fields.desc: A cave once filled with clean groundwater, now tainted by the contaminated Mystic Spring. With the fresh water cut off, all it attracts is creatures who thrive on its filth.

fields.title: Defunct Creion Laboratory
fields.desc: The Creion of Eltnen used their advanced technology to combat the desertification of the region and repel the invading Balaur. However, as Eltnen was never historically a stronghold for their race, their individual efforts quickly hit a wall, forcing most Creion to abandon the wasteland. Yet, a researcher named Malgerre refused to leave, determined to perfec

Elyos.name: Title: There's An Item For That

fields.title: Fallen Haven
fields.desc:
As Eltnen suffered relentless invasions by the Balaur and the Lepharists, many Daeva became part of the ever-growing list of casualties. Tifus, a Life Daeva, secretly moved the bodies of the fallen to a secluded cavern in the hopes that his kin could return to AION's embrace.
However, AION's fall made it impossible for the dead to return to Odyle. Instead, t

fields.title: Life Daeva Library
fields.desc:
A recently excavated cave archive that was hidden from the world for a long time. Likely built to store records detailing the construction of the Eiron Hill ruins nearby, its interior is now too deteriorated to yield any useful data.
Today, all that remains is the wandering spirits of the Life Daeva who once managed the archive.

fields.title: Lepharist Special Operations Research Center
fields.desc: A research facility packed with the Lepharists' most fanatical and aggressive special operations units. Driven by an obsession with strength, these radicals willingly become test subjects for their own experiments, fostering an atmosphere of ruthless competition in the name of enhancing combat performance.

fields.title: Ratcatchers Base
fields.desc: The base of the Ratcatchers, a group that kidnaps refugees in Lacephin Village and trades them for profit. Named after their tendency to refer to victims as 'rats', its members infamously revel in the criminality of their actions.

fields.title: Gravarax Research Center
fields.desc:
A research facility where countless Gravi are harvested to evolve into Gravarax.
Gravarax are an object of fascination for some Lepharist researchers due to their natural evolutionary processes. By studying Gravarax, these researchers seek to replicate the same mechanisms of evolution in their own test subjects.

Elyos.name: Title: Was Cute as a Kid

fields.title: Manduri Habitat
fields.desc: A Daeva hiding from the Balaur once cast a spell on the Manduri here for protection. However, the flawed spell caused the Manduri to become exceedingly aggressive. The Daeva fled, leaving only these furious creatures behind.

fields.title: Mutated Drana Plantation
fields.desc: A plantation for Drana built by the Balaur. These plantations can be found all across Elysea, as Drana are able to develop unique characteristics depending on their environment. The vegetation in this specific area is known to cause mutations in Drana.

fields.title: Sunken Temple
fields.desc: A temple so ancient that its origins are lost to time. Gradually flooded by seawater over eons, most of the structure and the valuables within now lie buried underwater. However, whispers persist of treasure waiting in areas yet to be swallowed by the sea.

fields.title: Barrier Tower Fortress Vault
fields.desc: A vault containing the riches of the Barrier Tower Fortress. Concentrated fire from the Balaur has reduced its entrance to rubble, giving it the unassuming appearance of a cave. The valuables within are still intact, though guarded by the wraiths of Daeva who fell during the attack.

fields.title: Forgotten Spring
fields.desc: A spring that was abandoned following the Balaur Invasion. Treasures moved here during its construction still remain. However, the area is highly dangerous, as Slimes contaminated by the Mystic Spring of Anathe roam the area.

fields.title: Fugitive Hideout
fields.desc: A hiding place storing items stolen by fugitives from Lacephin Village. The stash contains a variety of items, including a book on magic—which was used by one of the fugitives to seal the storage door.

fields.title: Iagosh's Secret Storage
fields.desc: A site that once housed records of research conducted by a Balaur named Iagosh and some humans. Today, all of those records have been destroyed or relocated, and the facility now serves as a temporary storage for all tribute collected from the Shugo.

fields.title: Abandoned Memorial Room
fields.desc: A memorial where the Nornir Priestess Soirel and the faithful once honored the memories of the dead. Their rites came to a tragic end when a sudden Balaur attack claimed the souls of all who had gathered there. Since then, the memorial has stood abandoned, unmaintained and unvisited.

fields.title: Trickster's Den
fields.desc: A lair of criminals exiled from Safe Haven now ruled by Korhe, the deceiver who once shattered the village from within through cunning and betrayal. Rumor has it the hideout is overflowing with stolen riches, plundered artifacts, and other spoils taken in the chaos of the village's downfall.

fields.title: Abandoned One's Grave
fields.desc: Not even noble blood could save you from the plague that spread after Odyle was depleted. Behit, the last surviving heir of a noble house that remained outside the Bulwark, buried his family with his own hands after they became Karas. He then entered the Abandoned Grave and sealed himself within.

fields.title: Dratona Cave
fields.desc: A cave full of Dratona eggs. The adult Dratona Baratuna vigilantly guards the eggs.

fields.title: Predator's Lair
fields.desc: Most of the Varg who escaped from the Lepharist Research Center became minions of the Dragon Lords, but some of them scattered and formed their own packs. The Varg who have settled in caves near the Purifying Forest slaughter or capture rare animals in the forest for illegal trade.

fields.title: Dusk Pit
fields.desc: A hiding place of Daeva who have strayed from the Daeva path and now serve the Balaur.

Asmodian.name: Title: A Floor Beneath the Floor

fields.title: Lost Ruins
fields.desc: A cave where a rift to the unstable Abyss has appeared. It contains information about the secrets of the Ancient City of Ru.

fields.title: Poisonous Plant Habitat
fields.desc: The miasma grows stronger with each passing day in a cave choked with poisonous plants. Within, the number of Agrints and slimes corrupted by the vegetation continues to rise.

fields.title: Valka's Nest
fields.desc: The nest of the Mutant Valka, a giant insectoid that was mutated by contaminants leaking out from the crashed Dredgion.

fields.title: Old Graveyard
fields.desc: A graveyard established during an age when countless humans and Daeva perished each day. The immense number of souls interred here, most denied even the dignity of a name, has turned it into a place few dare approach. Yet as rumors of buried treasures continue to spread, an increasing number of grave robbers have begun to take notice.

fields.title: Treasure Hunter's Residence
fields.desc: Long ago, treasure hunters fled to an abandoned ruin to escape a Balaur assault. They perished after being trapped within, and lingered on as vengeful revenants. Driven mad, they came to regard the ancient tome within as a priceless treasure, and now serve as its guardians.

Asmodian.name: Title: Only One Sacrifice Was Required

fields.title: Abandoned Archon Jail
fields.desc: Moslan Forest bandits have made a hideout out of an old prison for Asmodian Daeva.

fields.title: Fafnite Storage Room
fields.desc: This storage room is where the Balaur imprison Daeva to extract Fafnite from them. It is said to hold not only stores of Fafnium, but also Balaur records detailing the creation and properties of both Fafnite and Fafnium.

fields.title: Insectoid Tunnel
fields.desc: The ground beneath Altgard is weakening due to underground tunnels used by the burrowing insectoid. It is said the burrowing insectoids dwell in this cave.

fields.title: Bloodsoaked Confessional
fields.desc: Those who cling to twisted beliefs about Zikel gather within this chamber of repentance. These fanatics claim to be his most devoted followers, yet their misguided zeal has only deepened the misconceptions surrounding his true nature.

fields.title: Prison of Oblivion
fields.desc: An underground prison where those defeated in war were locked away. Over the years, the long-forgotten Prison of Oblivion has become filled only with restless dead and swarming rats, but rumors whisper of a lost chronicle hidden deep within its walls.

fields.title: Watcher's Temporary Outpost
fields.desc: A Draconute battalion is being temporarily stationed here to keep an eye on the Calderon Canyon.

Asmodian.name: Title: Can I Go to the Bathroom?

fields.title: Blue Dragon's Trap
fields.desc: A place where the Fafnium used throughout the Sanctum Outpost is managed by the Lagta Brigade. The Lagta Brigade has been using Fafnium created by Dragon Lord Fafnir to steal the souls of countless Daeva and control their empty flesh. This place is being guarded by Sentinel Nuraka of the Lagta Brigade.

fields.title: Hidden Vein Cave
fields.desc: A hidden cave rich in rare minerals. Crystalline monsters are swarming within.

fields.title: Fortuneteller's Grave
fields.desc: The Three Sisters of Fate who lead the Nornir are renowned diviners and prophets. Some of their disciples once claimed to surpass even their teachers in the art of prophecy. But when they foresaw themselves becoming Karas, they hid within this cave in fear, only to meet the very fate they sought to escape.

fields.title: Howling Den
fields.desc: The Mutated Varg Test Subjects were once human, but they no longer remember who they were. All that remains is the command to guard the treasure, a duty they obey without question.

fields.title: Ossuary of the Noble
fields.desc: During the Karas massacres, not even the nobles could escape their fate. Altgard's slaughterers rounded up the noble families suspected of being Karas, confined them within a single ossuary, and left them imprisoned there.

fields.title: Smuggler's Cave
fields.desc: Some of the Shulak criminals who roamed the Abyss continued their criminal activities even after settling in Altgard. In particular, a smuggler named Sumakhi will stop at nothing to make a profit and is now notorious among Daeva and humans for his brutality.

Asmodian.name: Title: I'll Teach You a Lesson

fields.title: Homish's Prison Compound
fields.desc: The creation of Fafnite always requires a living human or Daeva. To ensure a constant supply of sacrifices, the Drakan Homish constructed this prison compound to confine both humans and Daeva.

fields.title: Kumbahum's Cave
fields.desc: A cave used by those who seek the power of the Balaur over the honor of the Mau. Here, the followers of Shaman Kumbahum continue to grow in strength.

fields.title: Victims' Cave
fields.desc: The place where the soul-shattered cadets of Destruction Archons, slain for defying Hystan's command, are imprisoned in eternal despair

Asmodian.name: Title: You Have the Wrong Person

fields.title: Drana Depository
fields.desc: The Drana Depository of the Balaur, guarded by the Depository Manager Arya, infamous for his brutal slaying of Daeva.

Asmodian.name: Title: This Is Really Starting to Dragon

fields.title: High Priest's Ruins
fields.desc:
The body of High Priest Hystan, whose soul and mind were stolen by Fafnite, wandered through Altgard, slaughtering countless innocents in its wake.

When Hystan’s body finally reached Moslan Forest, the Nornir summoned the Daeva and sealed it away. To honor the victims, they erected a stele that preserves the truth of High Priest Hystan’s fate, and offerings

fields.title: Closed Hideout
fields.desc: Karas fled the village to this cave, but their fate could not be avoided. Though sealed in the past, the ravages of time have once again reopened this Karas-infested den. They continue to lurk within, mad and hungry for prey.

Asmodian.name: Title: I'll Take You All On

fields.title: All-Curing Cave
fields.desc:
This cave is rumored to contain a miraculous cure-all mushroom.
But none who've entered in search of it have ever returned.

fields.title: Fungie Habitat
fields.desc: A cave containing abnormal amounts of Fungie. Rumor says that treasure lies deep within, but none have successfully ventured far enough inside.

fields.title: Library of Wisdom
fields.desc: A secret library built by the librarian Musein to preserve the knowledge of the Asmodians, under the sworn protection of the Kerubar. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

fields.title: Destroyed Scriptorium
fields.desc: The ruins of a destroyed sanctum, said to contain records written by Empyrean Lord Zikel.

fields.title: Dark Root Cave
fields.desc: Home to an Agrint contaminated by Drana. A valuable treasure is said to lie unattended somewhere inside.

fields.title: Unstable Cave
fields.desc:
An underwater cavern serves as the lair of Daine of Tears, the Water Spirit who once escaped from the cave where the Etheria Rift was formed.

Now severed from its pact-bearer, the spirit remains in a dangerously unstable state, its essence in constant turmoil.

Asmodian.name: Title: I Finally Have Your Attention

fields.title: Lamnah Base
fields.desc: A cave claimed as a base by a Draconute warband led by Lamnah, the ruthless Scouts Captain of the Lagta Brigade.

fields.title: Twisted Pit
fields.desc: A twisted pit believed to descend into the Ancient City of Ru, known only to the most daring explorers. Rumors persist that the lost records of Ru are hidden within its depths.

fields.title: Rift Fissure
fields.desc:
A mysterious rift said to lead to the Ancient City of Ru, known only to seasoned explorers.

Rumors claim that the lost records of Ru lie hidden deep within this cave.

fields.title: Scale Altar
fields.desc: An altar where the Naga Wasti performs sacred rites to bolster the Dragon Lord's power. Renowned as a formidable warrior, Wasti is feared across the land as the Daeva Slayer.

fields.title: Library of Foresight
fields.desc: A library created in Moslan Forest by Musein, a librarian who sought to preserve the knowledge of the Asmodians by creating a secret library. Whispers tell of ancient tomes on the Bulwark kept within this library's depths.

Asmodian.name: Title: The High Walls of Pandemonium

fields.title: Skurv Laborer Den
fields.desc: A brutal training ground where Mumu Laborers are forged into warriors through relentless discipline. Those who fail to endure the overseer’s harsh regimen are cast into the depths of the prison’s grasp.

fields.title: Dratona Assembly Area
fields.desc: A hatchery and training ground for Dratona, a new kind of Balaur born in Atreia. Inherently fragile, they are often treated as expendable.

Asmodian.name: Title: This Is Not a Drill

fields.title: Place of Rest
fields.desc: A valley where Daeva who resisted the Balaur invasion once sought refuge, only to find it become their final resting place after a Dredgion bombardment. Many of those who fought here had served since the days before the Balaur invasion.

fields.title: Final Haven
fields.desc: In their darkest hour, a group of Daeva gathered what little they could and sought refuge in a hidden cave behind Basfelt Waterfall. Some ventured out to search for supplies or survivors, but none ever returned. Gripped by fear and despair, those who remained never left their sanctuary, choosing instead to wait in silence as hope slowly faded away.

fields.title: Worshiper's Underground Cave
fields.desc: Zikel's zealots grow their power within these underground caves. Corrupted followers blindly worship the kept records of Zikel, spreading false faith throughout Altgard.

fields.title: Fanatics' Den
fields.desc: Deep within this cave, Zikel’s zealots carry out grim rituals, driven by a warped devotion. The remains of their victims are gathered and laid before them as offerings, presented as tribute to Zikel.

Asmodian.name: Title: Don't Be Blinded by Greed

fields.title: Spider Cave
fields.desc: Rumors whisper of treasure hidden in this abandoned Odylium mine, but all who have ventured inside fell victim to swarms of Odyle Spiders.

fields.title: Empty Cave
fields.desc: An ancient cave once used by the Lepharists to conduct experiments on Krao. Though long abandoned, it is said that the surviving test subjects still roam its shadowy depths.

fields.title: Lonely Rock Chasm
fields.desc: An abandoned cave where a Daeva who betrayed the Blades was imprisoned, tortured, and left to die. It is said that the restless spirit of the traitor, along with the vengeful souls of other slain Daeva, haunts the cave and attacks all who dare enter.

Asmodian.name: Title: My Enemy's Enemy Is Still My Enemy

fields.title: Rock Cave
fields.desc: The Revelations of Khalil foretell the fate of the Daeva. A fragment of this ancient prophecy is said to lie hidden within this Rock Cave, guarded by the Kalgolem.

fields.title: Den of Exiles
fields.desc: This ruin houses ancient Daeva chronicles, but it has since been claimed by exiled Mau who abandoned their oaths and made it their own.

fields.title: Pirate's Treasure Storage
fields.desc: A hidden treasure vault beneath Idun's Lake once used by pirates to stash their plunder. After its discovery, the Blades seized the cache and placed it under the care of Custodian Chakkerman.

fields.title: Shulak Cave
fields.desc: A den imprisoning Razekin, a Shulak who survived Fafnite dust poisoning, but at the cost of his sanity.

fields.title: Destruction Archons Armory
fields.desc: An ancient armory of the Destruction Archons, dutifully guarded by their kin throughout the ages. Rumors speak of a hidden treasure concealed deep within its depths.

fields.title: Ascetic's Cave
fields.desc: A hidden refuge where Reckless Jonas, who fled the Blades to escape punishment, now hides alongside his followers. It was once a sanctuary where ascetics trained in solitude.

fields.title: Lagta Fafnite Storage
fields.desc: One of the Lagta Brigade's Fafnite Storages, overseen by the Supervisor Sinah.

fields.title: Warriors' Rest
fields.desc: A sanctum where the Destruction Archons, sworn to Zikel, find their final rest. Known as the Warriors' Rest, this ancient site is rumored to safeguard relics connected to Zikel.

fields.title: Tayga Breeding Ground
fields.desc: A breeding ground where the Black Claw Mau raise their fearsome Tayga. The grounds are forever filled with the scent of blood and the savage howls of these beasts.

fields.title: Library of Patience
fields.desc: A secret library built in Basfelt by Musein, a librarian who sought to preserve the knowledge of the Asmodians. Whispers tell of ancient tomes containing information on the Bulwark.

fields.title: Odylium Marauder Den
fields.desc: A storage housing the Blades' Odylium marauders. Fortified with powerful security devices, it holds vital documents tied to Odylium.

fields.title: Forgotten Fire Altar
fields.desc: An altar in a cave made by a Fire Temple worshiper. Though it once held ancient tomes revering the Fire Temple, it has been abandoned after an Artifact Fragment fell.

fields.title: Abandoned Kromede Base
fields.desc: A temporary base for Kromede, back when she was still active in Morheim. Abandoned ever since Kromede claimed the Sky Island as her base, it is now occupied by servants of Fafnir bewitched by the Domination Stone.

fields.title: Verdandi's Oratory
fields.desc: A hideout Verdandi stayed in when she came to Morheim with Skuld—before she settled in Patamor Village. Now, the area is occupied by Indnath's forces, who have been chasing Nemon all the way from Altgard.

Asmodian.name: Title: Would Still Plant My Apple Tree

fields.title: Blades Secret Repository
fields.desc: One of the storages used by the Blades when they were mainly operating in Morheim. Gerod is said to have frequented the repository despite the area's steep terrain.

fields.title: Frozen Land of Fate
fields.desc: A hideout where the surviving true Fate Archons once stayed. Pledging their eternal loyalty to their Empyrean Lord and High Priest, these Archons met their end here, unable to escape.

fields.title: Land of Raging Flame
fields.desc: A cave created to shield the Fire Temple from the humid ocean air. For eons, the Spirit guarding it remained faithful to an ancient promise made with Kromede—only to be consumed by wrath after rumors that she abandoned the temple and fled.

fields.title: Pure Spring
fields.desc: A spring near Muspel Volcano, located under a cliff so dangerous that not even the treasure hunter Kromede has dared to get close—or at least, according to the rumors. Many a starry-eyed explorer has ventured here in hopes of surpassing Kromede's glory.

fields.title: Predator's Nest
fields.desc: A cave that is home to the Giant Karnif Istan—a ferocious beast that emerged as the apex predator in a bitter, cold land without Mau. Strangely enough, it shares a nest with a Debry.

fields.title: Cave of the Stranded
fields.desc: A cave rumored to be haunted by the souls of Elyos unable to return to Elysea. Stories say that the Elyos here were trapped in Asmodae while investigating the Abyss alongside Deltras, the Guardian of Elysium.

fields.title: Cave of the Exiled Ones
fields.desc: A cave of violent outcasts that banded together after the Balaur emerged. Lately, their aggression has extended to Daeva, as well as the Balaur.

fields.title: Blades Base
fields.desc: The Blades' former base from when they were still active in Morheim. As remote as it is barren, it was the perfect location for them to continue their activities without alerting the residents of Patamor Village or Kromede's followers.

fields.title: Patamor Marauder Base
fields.desc: A cavern occupied by the outlaws of the Patamor Plains. Composed primarily of former Blades members, this gang has risen to infamy by robbing travelers and merchants journeying between Altgard and Morheim.

fields.title: Kurpak Special Operations Unit Base
fields.desc: The main base of a Taytra Brigade Kurpak unit under Sigebert's command. The unit is made up of swift and decisive soldiers that can be deployed anywhere in Iralcig Highland and Muspel Volcano Zone.

fields.title: Camouflaged Fate Archon Base
fields.desc: A training base for Fate Archons under Sigebert's command. What looks like an unassuming cave from the outside actually houses an elaborate fortress full of security devices meant to deter intruders.

Asmodian.name: Title: Guardian of a False Fate

fields.title: Fire Cave
fields.desc: Following the molten lava that flows deep within the cave leads directly into the heart of the Fire Temple. The spirits here, bound to the structure's power, became twisted and corrupted the very day Kromede abandoned the temple.

fields.title: Fate Temple
fields.desc: A temple where Fate Archon candidates once trained and studied Marchutan’s scriptures. Following the massacre of the instructors and candidates by Sigebert’s loyalists, the site is now haunted by vengeful souls who guard the temple's treasures from outsiders.

fields.title: Indnath Secret Base
fields.desc: A temporary base for Indnath, who has been chasing Nemon ever since the Lagta Fortress in Altgard. The base is meant to accommodate his forces temporarily until they can eliminate Nemon.

fields.title: Guardian Statues' Cave
fields.desc: An artificial cave created by Fire Temple worshipers. Much care went into maintaining the cave, as the Guardian statues were relocated in an attempt to counteract Water Aura from the ocean. Now, however, it lies abandoned.

fields.title: Iralcig Naga Cave
fields.desc: A cave occupied by Naga who reluctantly follow Sigebert's command in the absence of their leader, Dragon Lord Fafnir. They share frosty relations with the Fate Archons, and consider the Krall to be beneath them.

fields.title: Patamor Underwater Cave
fields.desc: The entrance to a subterranean cave system flooded with groundwater. Rumors speak of treasure awaiting in the depths of the cave, drawing the attention of fortune seekers time and time again.

fields.title: Ruins of the Ancient City of Roah
fields.desc:
According to legend, the Ancient City of Ru was once the pinnacle of Atreian civilization, until it was consumed by the Abyss and vanished without a trace. For generations, its fate remained a mystery, with only scattered fragments of the once-magnificent city ever discovered in Reshanta.
